question_text: A 2-year-old girl is brought to the emergency department by her mother because the girl has had a cough and shortness of breath for the past 2 hours. Her symptoms began shortly after she was left unattended while eating watermelon. She appears anxious and mildly distressed. Examination shows intercostal retractions and unilateral diminished breath sounds with inspiratory wheezing. Flexible bronchoscopy is most likely to show a foreign body in which of the following locations?
